note: Screens for the portfolio. VYRO and Baby were captured on Tanishq's PC with Snipping Tool and cropped to the app window. menumesh/ and jainav/ are filled by scripts/capture (spec §15.2). Videos were recorded with Xbox Game Bar (window capture, so no other windows appear), trimmed and encoded to muted H.264 at 30 fps.

screens.alt: VYRO dashboard: animated CPU and GPU speedometers at 47% and 46% with clocks of 5,123 and 2,812 MHz, live tiles and per-thread load bars.
VYRO Health view: every subsystem within normal limits, a diagnostics panel and alert rules for CPU and GPU temperature.
screens.use: Case study: on top of the readings

screens.alt: VYRO Gaming view: game profiles and recorded sessions with average FPS, 1% and 0.1% lows and what limited the frame rate.
VYRO fan control: each fan header follows the BIOS curve, with fixed and custom-curve options and full-speed safety limits.
VYRO replay of a 44-minute cs2 session: frame rate, frame time, CPU and GPU usage and temperatures over time.
VYRO My PC view: a 3-D model of the PC with each part labelled by temperature and airflow lines through the case.
VYRO Sensors table listing every reading with its value, minimum, maximum, average and source.
VYRO appearance settings: six themes, an accent colour wheel, update-rate profiles and an overlay preview.
